hub.hanabi_desc: You can't see your own cards. Read your teammates' clues and build the fireworks before the powder blows.
hub.cah_desc: Fill in the black card with the most absurd white card in your hand and win over the round's Czar.
hub.ludo_desc: Roll the die, get a 6 to leave base, capture pawns and bring all 4 home — against friends or bots.

itto.lobby_desc: 2 to 8 players. Co-op: everyone wins or loses together.
itto.howto_1: Everyone gets a secret number from 1 to 100.
itto.howto_2: Give a clue about the theme that matches your number.
itto.howto_3: Together, sort the cards from lowest to highest.
itto.rule1_body: Each player gets secret numbers from 1 to 100. Based on the round's theme, give a clue proportional to your number.
itto.rule2_body: Without revealing numbers, the group discusses the clues and drags the cards into ascending order, 1 to 100.
itto.rule3_body: Never say numbers or use tricks to reveal values.
itto.status_write_detail: Think of the theme and your number
itto.sorting_hint: If anyone moves a card, everyone has to agree again.

hanabi.lobby_desc: 2 to 5 players. The host picks a variant and everyone marks “I'm ready”.
hanabi.howto_1: You see your teammates' cards, never your own.
hanabi.howto_2: On your turn: give a clue, discard, or play a card.
hanabi.howto_3: Build each color from 1 to 5 before 3 explosions.

rainbow_full.name: Full rainbow
rainbow_full.subtitle: 6 colors · 60 cards · up to 30 points
rainbow_full.desc: Adds a 6th multicolor suit with 10 cards.

rainbow_one.name: Single rainbow
rainbow_one.subtitle: 6 colors · 55 cards · high stakes
rainbow_one.desc: The 6th suit has one copy of each number. Discarding it is fatal.

rainbow_wild.name: Wild rainbow
rainbow_wild.subtitle: 6 colors · 60 cards · wild clues
rainbow_wild.desc: Multicolor cards respond to any color clue.

hanabi.modifier_perfect_show_desc: The game doesn't end when the deck runs out: only when every firework is complete or an essential card is discarded.
hanabi.rule1_body: Build each color's firework in order: 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5.
hanabi.rule2_body: You hold your cards facing the others: you never see your own.
hanabi.rule3_body: Give a clue (costs 1 token and points out every card of one color or number in a teammate's hand), discard (regains 1 token) or play a card (a wrong card explodes and burns 1 fuse; 3 explosions end the game).
hanabi.rule4_body: Completing a color with its 5 gives the team 1 clue token back.
hanabi.status_your_turn_detail: Play, discard or give a clue
hanabi.my_hand_note: You only see the clues you got
hanabi.discard_card_disabled_tooltip: You can't discard with all 8 clues available.
hanabi.give_clue_modal_desc: Costs 1 token and points out every card in their hand that matches your pick.
hanabi.give_clue_modal_wild_desc: Wild rule: multicolor cards light up for any color.
hanabi.discarded_modal_desc: Each color has three 1s, two 2s, two 3s, two 4s and a single 5 (single rainbow: one of each).
hanabi.toast_five_bonus_sub: {{user}} played the 5 and the team got 1 clue token back.

cah.lobby_desc: 3 to 12 players. Each round, a different Czar picks the funniest answer.
cah.howto_1: The round's Czar shows a black card.
cah.howto_2: Everyone else completes it with white cards from their hand.
cah.howto_3: The Czar picks a favorite without knowing whose it is.
cah.rule1_body: Each round one player is the Czar and shows a black card with a question or phrase to complete.
cah.rule2_body: Everyone else secretly picks their funniest or most absurd white cards to complete it.
cah.rule3_body: The Czar reads the anonymous answers and picks a favorite. Its owner scores 1 point.
cah.status_reveal: Flip the cards one by one
cah.czar_no_play: The Czar sits this round out
cah.waiting_czar_advance: Waiting for {{name}} or the host to continue.

ludo.lobby_desc: 1 to 4 players. Empty seats can be filled with bots.
ludo.howto_1: Roll a 6 to bring a pawn out of base.
ludo.howto_2: Land on an opponent to send them back (except on stars).
ludo.howto_3: Bring all 4 pawns to the center to win.
ludo.rule1_body: Each player has 4 pawns in base. Roll a 6 to put one on the track.
ludo.rule2_body: Landing on an opponent's pawn sends it back to base, except on star squares.
ludo.rule3_body: Go all the way around, enter your color's lane and bring all 4 pawns to the center.
ludo.hint_roll: Roll the die. A 6 brings a pawn out of base.
ludo.select_pawn: Tap a pulsing pawn to move it.
ludo.extra_turn_capture_banner: {{name}} captured a pawn and goes again
ludo.podium_choice_desc: All 4 pawns are home! Keep playing for 2nd and 3rd?
ludo.waiting_leader_podium: Waiting for the host to decide.

wavelength.lobby_desc: 2 or more players, all on one team.
wavelength.howto_1: The Psychic sees where the hidden target is on the spectrum.
wavelength.howto_2: They give a short clue pointing to that spot.
wavelength.howto_3: The team turns the dial and locks in a guess.
wavelength.rule1_body: One player becomes the Psychic and sees a hidden target from 0% to 100%. They give a clue proportional to its position.
wavelength.rule2_body: Everyone else discusses the clue and turns the dial to where they think the target is.
wavelength.rule3_body: Dead center scores 4, the middle band 3 and the outer band 2.
wavelength.status_give_clue: Give a clue for the target
wavelength.status_confirm: Lock it in when you agree
wavelength.waiting_psychic_clue_named: Waiting for {{name}} to give a clue.
wavelength.psychic_silence: Quiet: let the team debate and set the dial.
wavelength.rating_low_desc: The waves crossed. Worth another try!
